info.title: Bunkarr API
info.description: Bunkarr REST API. Authenticate with the API key from Settings > General in the X-Api-Key header (or the apikey query parameter), or with a login session cookie. The *arr webhook routes (/webhook/...) accept only an integration's webhook key instead. Errors are {"message": "..."}: 400 invalid input, 401 not authenticated, 403 refused (a cross-site browser request, an action that needs a login session, a directory Bunkarr cannot read), 404 unknown id, 409 conflict with the current state (including safety refusals that need a confirmation or a mounted share), 429 too many requests (Retry-After), 502 Plex, plex.tv or an *arr failed, 503 unavailable (the backup routes of a server without backup services, or a request stopped as the server shuts down), 500 anything else. Secrets (Plex tokens, *arr API keys, Apprise URLs) are write-only; a webhook key appears only in POST /integrations/{id}/webhook/key. Job-starting endpoints answer 202 with the queued Job. Sizes are bytes, times RFC 3339.

webhookKeyBasic.description: The integration's webhook key as the Basic password (the user name is ignored)

webhookKeyHeader.name: X-Api-Key
webhookKeyHeader.description: The integration's webhook key (never Bunkarr's API key)

webhookKeyQuery.name: apikey
webhookKeyQuery.description: The integration's webhook key (never Bunkarr's API key)

JobParams.description: What a job works on; zero values are left out.

allowChanges.description: Run the changes the mass-change guard would hold (S10b); on a refresh, the deletions and cache shrinks the refresh guard held.

paths.description: A targeted sync: only these paths inside its one source (sourceIds holds one id).

arrItemIds.description: A targeted refresh: only these *arr items (the *arr's movie, series or artist ids).

syncAfter.description: A refresh queues follow-up syncs of the changed items' folders when it ends.

releaseDemoted.description: A sync releases files whose tier is no longer full (Phase 3).

releaseOf.description: The dry run whose release items a releaseDemoted run applies.

releaseRevision.description: The tier rule revision that dry run evaluated.

prune.description: A retention job of one restic destination prunes its repository now.

readData.description: A verify job reads everything once (restic check --read-data; every file on rclone and filecopy).

phase.description: scanning, planning, copying, verifying, backing-up, finishing

batches.description: Engine jobs: the batches planned so far

limitBytesPerSec.description: The upload limit in force (0 or missing: none)

windowEndsAt.description: When the destination's transfer window closes

stats.description: Runner-specific counters, e.g. sync: filesPlanned, filesCopied, filesUpdated, filesMoved, filesAdopted, filesLinked, filesRetained, filesDisplaced, filesHeld, filesFailed, filesSkipped, bytesPlanned, bytesCopied, durationMs, and with tier rules: tiers {full, manifest, skip, unknownPromoted: {files, bytes}}, filesKept, bytesKept, filesReleased, bytesReleased, movedToNonFull, staleReferences, tierRevision; refresh: items, itemsAdded, itemsUpdated, itemsDeleted, files, filesMapped, filesUnmapped, filesMismatched, guardHeld, followUpJobs (Plex index, Tautulli, Seerr, Maintainerr: items, files, requests and a type-specific cache object); arr_backup: method, reusedScheduled, unchanged, bytes, integrity, snapshotId, versionsPruned; manifest_export: items, files, bytes, unchanged, damagedFound, manifestId, versionsPruned. Engine jobs (restic, rclone) add: sync: engine, batches, bytesUploaded, bytesRead, snapshots [{sourceId, snapshotId, batch, filesNew, filesChanged, filesUnmodified, dataAdded}], unchanged, deferrals, limitKiBps; verify: engine, check {numErrors, readSubset}, sampleFiles, sampleBytes, versionsChecked; retention: engine, snapshotsForgotten, snapshotsKept, forgetRequests, pruned, pruneDurationMs, cleanup. Engine jobs (restic, rclone) add: sync: engine, batches, bytesUploaded, bytesRead, snapshots [{sourceId, snapshotId, batch, filesNew, filesChanged, filesUnmodified, dataAdded}], unchanged, deferrals, limitKiBps; verify: engine, check {numErrors, readSubset}, sampleFiles, sampleBytes, versionsChecked; retention: engine, snapshotsForgotten, snapshotsKept, forgetRequests, pruned, pruneDurationMs, cleanup.

notBefore.description: A queued job that a transfer window deferred does not start before this time

deferrals.description: How often a transfer window deferred the job

Item.description: One planned unit of work of a job (a dry run's items are its preview).

detail.description: Runner-specific: source path, temp path, link target, reason.

ItemPage.description: One page of a job's items, in plan order.

cron.description: 5-field cron expression or @hourly/@daily/@weekly/@monthly, in the container's time zone; "" means none.

blockedReason.description: Why the scheduler refuses this schedule's jobs, e.g. 'destination "UNAS" is disabled' or 'destination "B2": export and confirm the recovery kit first' (its destination or Plex server is disabled, or an engine destination's create did not finish, its recovery kit is not confirmed or its engine is not available; Run now answers 409 too); empty when they can run

lastSkip.description: Why the last fire queued no job (the same job still running, or a deferred job of the destination waiting for its transfer window); null when it did

plex.description: Path prefix as Plex sees it

local.description: The same folder as Bunkarr sees it

PlexBackup.description: The scheduled Plex DB backups: one plexdb_backup schedule per target.

targets.description: Up to 4 targets (always returned). The single form (destinationId, cron, enabled) is the first target; a request that sends only it replaces targets[0] and keeps the others.

dataPath.description: The Plex Media Server data directory mounted into Bunkarr (read-only)

hasApiKey.description: The API key (Plex token) itself is never returned.

settings.description: Type-specific: PlexSettings (plex), ArrSettings (sonarr, radarr, lidarr) or MetaSettings (tautulli, seerr, maintainerr).

IntegrationInput.description: type is required on create and cannot change.

url.description: http(s) base URL without credentials, query or fragment

apiKey.description: Write-only. Empty or missing on update keeps the stored key.

clearApiKey.description: Update only: remove the stored key.

settings.description: Type-specific: PlexSettings (plex), ArrSettings (sonarr, radarr, lidarr) or MetaSettings (tautulli, seerr, maintainerr). Missing on update keeps them.

plexSignIn.description: Plex only, in place of apiKey (not together with apiKey or clearApiKey). A saved integration consumes the sign-in.

currentPassword.description: The logged-in user's password (S29). Required, with a login session, when the request sends data off-site or relaxes a safety check; a wrong one is 400 and counts as a failed login; the API key and the local bypass get 403.

type.description: Required unless id is given (then it defaults to the saved integration's type)

id.description: A saved integration whose stored key is used when apiKey is empty (0: none)

settings.description: Unsaved settings to test with (*arr: pathMappings, backupFolder), validated like a create, except that Tautulli and Maintainerr may leave plexIntegrationId unset or 0 (no Plex server chosen yet; plexMatches is then null)

plexSignIn.description: Plex only: test with the chosen server's token (the sign-in is not consumed)

manualBackups.description: Manual backups the *arr keeps (it never prunes them)

rootFolders.description: Mapped with the tested path mappings; null when they could not be read

fileDate.description: The *arr's change-file-date setting; anything but none is a warning

plexMatches.description: Tautulli and Maintainerr: whether the application works with the linked Plex server (null without a plexIntegrationId, or when it cannot be told)

IntegrationTestResult.description: Plex: version, machineIdentifier and the butler window. Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr: appName, backup, manualBackups, rootFolders, recycleBin, fileDate. Tautulli, Seerr, Maintainerr: version, appName and (Tautulli, Maintainerr) plexMatches.

localPath.description: As Bunkarr sees it through the path mappings; "" when no mapping applies

destinationId.description: 0 or missing: the integration's backup destination

fsType.description: Recorded by the first successful scan after the source was saved

destFolder.description: Empty: create derives it from the name, update keeps it. Immutable once backed up (409).

path.description: The resolved path that would be stored

CatalogFilePage.description: One page of a source's catalog, by relative path.

truncated.description: More than 10000 subdirectories; the first ones are listed

Capabilities.description: What the destination probe found (design section 3).

unstableInodes.description: Inode numbers do not tell whether two names at the destination are one file: a hardlinked name (or another spelling on a case-insensitive destination) stats with other numbers than the name it is one file with, as on a CIFS mount with noserverino. Bunkarr then compares such names by content. A sync, verify or retention job that is not a dry run checks this again before it first compares two names and stores a change.

probeVersion.description: Version of the probe that found these capabilities (currently 1). 0 or missing: an older probe that did not check unstableInodes; the next sync, verify or retention job that is not a dry run probes the destination again, and until then inode numbers are not trusted.

enforcesModes.description: The destination keeps a file's permission bits (the probe writes a file with mode 0600 and reads the mode back; SMB without POSIX extensions does not). *arr backups need it unless their integration sets backup.acceptInsecureModes. Missing or false until a probe that checks it.

DestinationSettings.description: Missing or zero values take the defaults. transfers, verify.sampleMaxBytes, restic and rclone apply to those engines only (400 on another engine).

sampleMaxBytes.description: restic and rclone: the most bytes one sample verify reads (default 4 GiB restic, 16 GiB rclone)

Retention.description: Missing or zero values take the defaults (deletedDays 30, plexDbDaily 14, plexDbWeekly 8, arrDaily 14, arrWeekly 8, manifestDays 30, manifestWeeks 12), except manifestWeeks 0, which keeps no weekly manifest versions.

arrDaily.description: Daily *arr backup versions kept per integration

arrWeekly.description: ISO weeks that keep their newest *arr backup version

manifestDays.description: Days that keep their newest manifest version

manifestWeeks.description: ISO weeks that keep their newest manifest version (0 keeps none; missing is 12)

snapshotDaily.description: restic only: periods that keep their newest complete snapshot (0 keeps none)

snapshotWeekly.description: restic only: periods that keep their newest complete snapshot (0 keeps none)

snapshotMonthly.description: restic only: periods that keep their newest complete snapshot (0 keeps none)

snapshotYearly.description: restic only: periods that keep their newest complete snapshot (0 keeps none)

target.description: A local destination's resolved path, or a remote's display location (sftp://user@host:22/path, s3:<endpoint>/<bucket>/<prefix>, b2:<bucket>/<prefix>)

lastJob.description: The newest job of any type that worked on the destination (sync, verify, retention, Plex DB backup)

lastSync.description: The newest sync of the destination (queued, running or finished; previews excluded): its last sync status. null before the first sync

hasCredentials.description: The storage credential fields that are stored (never a value)

pending.description: A create that initialized a repository has not finished: no job runs; create the same location again to finish it, or delete it

blockedReason.description: Why no job but a dry run runs: the create did not finish, the recovery kit is not confirmed, or the engine is not available

warnings.description: Warnings of the create or update that returned it (not stored)

engineVersion.description: restic and rclone: the installed engine's version

retentionSchedule.description: restic and rclone: the destination's own retention schedule (filecopy: the global retention job)

waitingUntil.description: When a job waiting for the transfer window starts again; null when none waits

DestinationInput.description: Create: name is required, and target for a local destination. Update: empty or missing fields keep the stored values; kind, engine, target, the remote's location and the encryption cannot change. S29 (a login session and currentPassword): creating a destination whose kind is not local or with acceptUnencrypted; updating credentials, remote.hostKeys or remote.caCert, or linking a source to a destination whose kind is not local.

target.description: A local destination's absolute path (a mounted share); it must exist. Remote kinds use remote. Cannot change after creation.

schedule.description: Sync schedule. Create: missing means none. Update: missing keeps it. {cron: "", enabled: false} removes it.

verifySchedule.description: Verify schedule. Create: missing means 0 5 * * 0 (weekly, Sunday 05:00). Update: missing keeps it.

attach.description: Create only: adopt the existing marker (filecopy, rclone) or restic repository (S3); a restic repository needs its password as encryption.secret.

allowLocal.description: Create only: accept a target on a local filesystem (S3).

retentionSchedule.description: restic and rclone only. Create: missing means 30 4 * * * (daily). Update: missing keeps it.

currentPassword.description: The logged-in user's password (S29). Required, with a login session, when the request sends data off-site or relaxes a safety check; a wrong one is 400 and counts as a failed login; the API key and the local bypass get 403.

DestinationTest.description: A filecopy target ({target}), or the connection of a restic or rclone destination to create ({kind, engine, target, remote, credentials, encryption}). Never an id or a stored secret.

dryRun.description: Scan, plan and guard only; nothing is written (S9)

allowChanges.description: Run changes the mass-change guard holds (S10b)

releaseDemoted.description: Release files whose tier is no longer full (removed from the destination). With dryRun: the release preview. Without: needs releaseOf and releaseRevision

releaseOf.description: The finished release preview (dry run) this release applies; 409 unless it is one of this destination

releaseRevision.description: The rule revision that preview evaluated; 409 when the rules changed since

readData.description: Read everything once: restic check --read-data, every recorded file on rclone, every file's hash on filecopy

dryRun.description: Queue a dry run (a preview): nothing is written or deleted (S9)

path.description: Version directory relative to the target (empty for media snapshots)

method.description: plexdb: online_backup or online_backup_immutable; arr: arr_api_folder (read from the mounted Backups folder) or arr_api_http

engineRef.description: restic and rclone: the snapshot id or remote path

dataAdded.description: media only: bytes this snapshot added to the repository

Snapshot.description: A recorded version at a destination: a Plex DB version (kind plexdb), an *arr backup (kind arr, never served), or on a restic destination a media snapshot of one source and batch (kind media).

configKey.description: Apprise stateful mode; "" means stateless with the stored URLs

hasUrls.description: The Apprise URLs themselves are never returned.

urls.description: Write-only Apprise URLs (comma or space separated); empty on update keeps the stored ones.

NotificationTest.description: A notification form (apiUrl and urls or configKey required) or just the id of a saved notification.

id.description: A saved notification: empty urls use its stored URLs; an id without apiUrl tests it as saved.

arr.description: Path prefix as the *arr sees it

local.description: The same folder as Bunkarr sees it

ArrBackup.description: The scheduled *arr backups: one arr_backup schedule per target.

maxScheduledAgeDays.description: A scheduled backup of the *arr younger than this is copied instead of asking for a new one

acceptInsecureModes.description: The single form's (targets[0]) flag: allow a destination whose capabilities.enforcesModes is false (the zips hold the *arr's secrets); otherwise saving such a destination is 400. Setting it is S29.

targets.description: Up to 4 targets (always returned). The single form (destinationId, cron, enabled) is the first target; a request that sends only it replaces targets[0] and keeps the others.

RefreshSettings.description: The scheduled full refresh of the metadata cache (managed as a refresh schedule).

staleAfterHours.description: The cache's facts are unknown this long after its last complete refresh (*arr default 24)

ArrSettings.description: Settings of a Sonarr, Radarr or Lidarr integration; missing fields take the defaults.

backupFolder.description: The *arr's Backups folder as Bunkarr sees it (mounted read-only); empty fetches backups over HTTP

MetaSettings.description: Settings of a Tautulli, Seerr or Maintainerr integration.

PlexSignInRef.description: A server chosen in "Sign in with Plex": the server side uses its token (never sent to the browser) after checking that the URL answers /identity as that server.

useAccountToken.description: An owned server that plex.tv lists without a token of its own: use the account token

http.description: Found by a 1-byte range GET of the newest backup; unknown when none exists

localPath.description: Through the path mappings; null when none applies

sourceId.description: The source localPath lies in; null when none

reason.description: Why the folder is not usable; empty when it is

status.description: Outcome of the last refresh (full or targeted)

refreshedAt.description: Start of the last complete refresh

stats.description: Counts of the last full refresh (items, files, filesMapped, filesUnmapped, filesMismatched, unmappedFolders, inaccessibleRootFolders, recycleBin, fileDate, guardHeld)

instanceMatches.description: The cache was built from the integration's current URL

reason.description: Why the cache is not fresh

allowChanges.description: Apply the deletions and shrinks the refresh guard would hold

localPath.description: Through the path mappings; null when none applies

sourceId.description: The source localPath lies in; null when none

ArrMetadata.description: An *arr's metadata as indexed by its last refresh.

localPath.description: Through the stored path mappings; null when none applies

sourceId.description: The source localPath lies in; null when none

exists.description: localPath is a directory Bunkarr can see

rotate.description: false: reveal the current key; true: replace it (the old key stops working at once)

key.description: The only response that contains a webhook key

localPath.description: Through the path mappings; absent when unmapped

reason.description: unmapped: no path mapping applies; no-source: the mapped path lies in no source; mismatched: no live catalog file has the mapped path and the application's size

catalogSize.description: The size of the catalog file at the path, when the sizes differ

integrationId.description: null once the integration was deleted

eventType.description: As the *arr sent it, e.g. Download, MovieFileDelete, Test

outcome.description: null while the event waits to be processed

jobId.description: The refresh the event went into

truncated.description: The body was larger than 64 KiB compacted: only the event type and the item ids were stored

files.description: Paths as the *arr reports them (shown, never opened)

payload.description: The body as received (compact JSON) when it is at most 64 KiB; a larger one is stored as {"truncated": true, "eventType": …, "ids": […]}

path.description: The integration's own webhook route, e.g. /api/v1/webhook/radarr/3

last24h.description: Events received in the last 24 hours

warnings.description: A linked destination without a sync schedule; another integration of the app that received events on the generic route in the last 7 days

destinationId.description: 0 or missing: the integration's backup destination

authUrl.description: Open in a popup: app.plex.tv's approval page (the only place the PIN code appears)

PlexServerChoice.description: A server of the signed-in account (no token: hasAccessToken says whether plex.tv lists one).

useAccountToken.description: An owned server without a token of its own: probe with the account token

derived.description: Not listed by plex.tv: derived from a listed connection

identityMatches.description: /identity answered as the chosen server (the token is sent only then)

recommended.description: A working https, non-relay connection to preselect; null when none

Manifest.description: A manifest version written to a destination.

jobId.description: 0 once that job's history was deleted

path.description: Version directory relative to the target

bytes.description: Size of the files the manifest lists

integrity.description: damaged: missing or not matching its checksums when read back; not downloadable

Tier.description: What a destination does with a file: full copies it; manifest lists it in the manifests only; skip neither copies nor lists it (an *arr file is still listed in its item).

op.description: The operators a field takes are listed by GET /tiers/fields

value.description: Of the field's valueType (bool, string, a non-negative integer, or a non-empty list of Seerr user ids); none for never

destinationIds.description: Applies at: null is every destination, a list only those, an empty list none

id.description: A saved rule's id; missing or 0 is a new rule

destinationIds.description: Applies at: null or missing is every destination, [] none

TierRuleSet.description: The rules in priority order. With no rules every file is full.

revision.description: Changes with every save; a save must send the revision it loaded
The revision the rules were loaded at (a stale one gets 409)

rules.description: The whole set; the array order is the priority

TierWarning.description: A rule value no fresh index knows (a renamed tag or profile): the condition is false or unknown everywhere.

TierPreset.description: A rule set the editor can load; nothing is applied until it is saved.

reason.description: Why the field is not available

suggestions.description: Tags, profiles, root folders, Plex libraries, sources, genres and Seerr users (labels read live)

rules.description: A draft to preview; missing previews the saved rules

destinationIds.description: Only these destinations (missing: every enabled one)

uniqueBytes.description: The content once per hardlink group

DeletedIntegration.description: A deleted *arr integration as the tier facts remember it (tiers.deletedArr)

folders.description: Its mapped root folders, and mapped item folders outside them, as Bunkarr sees them

unmapped.description: Its root folders (as the *arr sees them) no path mapping covered: every file no live *arr claims stays unknown while the record exists

TierConfigBackup.description: A Plex DB or *arr backup aimed at the destination: always full, never tiered.

lastBytes.description: Size of its newest version (0: none yet)

stored.description: What the live records hold now

unknownPromoted.description: Full only because a fact is unknown

toCopy.description: Full files without an up-to-date record

kept.description: Non-full files with a record: what a release would free

movedToNonFull.description: Backed-up files that reappeared in another source of the destination under a non-full tier

TierPreview.description: Kept for 10 minutes (at most 4 at a time); its items are read with GET /tiers/preview/{id}/items.

revision.description: The saved rules' revision, or draft for rules sent with the request

unknownSources.description: Caches whose facts are unknown now, and why

TierReason.description: One evaluated condition. Rule id 0 with field flag.irreplaceable is the built-in irreplaceable override.

actual.description: What the value was compared with (a Seerr user by id only)

unknown.description: The unknown conditions of the rules evaluated before the decision

unknownPromoted.description: Full only because a more protective rule could not be decided

follows.description: The file whose decision this is (a sidecar's media file, a hardlink group's most protective name)

ItemFlag.description: A manual flag. An *arr flag follows the item's external ids (re-adds, renames, moves); a path flag covers a file, or every file under a folder, of a source.

integrationId.description: *arr flags: the integration it was set on (null once deleted)

lastSourceId.description: *arr flags: where the item was last located

relPath.description: Path flags: the file or folder (empty: the whole source)

resolved.description: Whether the flag covers something now

target.description: An *arr item or a path, not both

relPath.description: A clean relative path; empty is the whole source

FileFacts.description: A file's tier facts; null parts are not read (no such integration).

byFolder.description: Attributed to the item whose folder contains it (an extra)

lowerBound.description: Some history is not kept: the counts are lower bounds

flags.description: Ids of the flags that cover the file

unknown.description: The fact sources that are unknown for the file, and why. Tautulli, Seerr and Maintainerr are left out while no integration of that application is set up (their facts still carry the reason)

FileDetail.description: A live catalog file, its facts, and its tier at every destination linked to its source.

record.description: The destination's live record of the file (null: none)

SeerrUser.description: A Seerr user; the label is built from user names only (never an e-mail).

PlexIndexSettings.description: The Plex library index (sections, items, files) that the Tautulli and Maintainerr joins and the plex.section tier field read; managed as a refresh schedule.

DestKind.description: Where a destination is: a folder in the container (a mounted share), an SFTP server, S3-compatible storage or Backblaze B2. Cannot change after creation.

DestEngine.description: filecopy (plain files, local only), restic (an encrypted, deduplicated repository) or rclone (a plain copy of the files, encrypted with rclone crypt by default). Cannot change after creation.

EncryptionMode.description: none: plain files (filecopy; rclone only with acceptUnencrypted); restic: the repository's own encryption; crypt: an rclone crypt remote over the destination.

key.description: The key in base64 SSH wire format
The key in base64 SSH wire format (pin it as a HostKey)

path.description: Absolute, or relative to the login directory

hostKeys.description: The pinned host keys (from POST /destinations/sftp/hostkeys). Required to create; a test without them answers the presented keys. Changing them is S29.

endpoint.description: https URL; empty for AWS (the region's endpoint)

storageClass.description: One the provider offers; empty for its default

caCert.description: One PEM certificate for a self-signed endpoint (empty: the system roots). Changing it is S29.

Remote.description: A remote kind's non-secret location (phase4.md §4.2), decoded strictly for the kind: SFTPRemote (sftp), S3Remote (s3), B2Remote (b2); {} for local.

StorageCredentials.description: Write-only storage credentials (never returned; hasCredentials names the stored fields). sftp: privateKey (+ privateKeyPassphrase) or password; s3: accessKeyId and secretAccessKey; b2: keyId and applicationKey. On update the fields sent replace the stored ones (tested first against the stored remote; S29), except sftp: privateKey or password sent replaces the whole login (privateKey, privateKeyPassphrase and password; a stored passphrase is kept only when it opens a newly sent encrypted key and no passphrase is sent), and privateKeyPassphrase alone keeps the stored key; null and {} are refused.

EncryptionInput.description: Create only (it cannot change): restic always encrypts (mode restic); rclone uses crypt unless mode none with acceptUnencrypted (S29). The secret is generated unless the user gives one (at least 16 characters; attaching an existing repository needs it). A generated or typed secret is shown only in the recovery kit.

acceptUnencrypted.description: Needed for mode none: the provider can read every file (S29)

secret2.description: rclone crypt's password2 (the salt), only with the user's secret (refused without it and on restic). Attaching a crypt remote whose recovery kit lists a password2 (every one whose crypt passwords Bunkarr generated) needs both ("rclone crypt password" as secret, "rclone crypt password2" as secret2); omitted, password2 stays rclone's default, for a kit that lists none or a crypt remote made with a password only. Same rules as secret: at least 16 characters, no leading or trailing whitespace. A crypt remote created with a secret2 confirms its recovery kit with the check code.

origin.description: Who chose the secret; empty: no secret

kitConfirmedAt.description: null while the recovery kit custody is not confirmed: no job but a dry run runs (S21)

to.description: Before from: runs into the next day

BandwidthWindow.description: Sync, verify and retention jobs run only inside the window; a job still running at its end plus graceMinutes is stopped and waits for the next opening (a deferred job).

allowOverrun.description: Let a file larger than the window start alone at its opening and run past its end

Bandwidth.description: Limits in KiB/s (0: unlimited), a weekly timetable of other limits and a transfer window, in the container's time zone (phase4.md §9.1, §9.2). Engine destinations and filecopy.

ResticSettings.description: A restic destination's settings; missing or zero values take the defaults.

pruneMaxUnused.description: A percentage (10%), a size (5G) or unlimited

RcloneSettings.description: An rclone destination's settings; missing or zero values take the defaults.

EngineState.description: A restic or rclone destination's engine state (engine_state): zero values before its first job.

engineVersion.description: The engine at the last job

readSubsetNext.description: n of the next restic check --read-data-subset=n/t

stats.description: Repository or remote figures (e.g. snapshotCount, repositoryBytes)

EngineTestResult.description: The test of a restic or rclone destination (phase4.md §4.5). Problems with the location are reported here (ok false, message); the request's secrets are redacted.

id.description: The repository id (restic) or the marker's id (rclone)

markerName.description: The destination name in the marker

hostKeys.description: sftp without pinned keys: the keys the server presents (nothing else ran)

reason.description: Why the engine is not available

EngineAvailability.description: What start-up found for the restic and rclone binaries.

uploadSlots.description: How many engine syncs (not dry runs) upload at once

retryBudgetMinutes.description: How long an engine command may keep retrying before it is stopped

uploadSlotsInEffect.description: The slot count in use (read at start-up)

restartRequired.description: uploadSlots differs from the count in effect: it applies after a restart

currentPassword.description: The logged-in user's password (S29). Required, with a login session, when the request sends data off-site or relaxes a safety check; a wrong one is 400 and counts as a failed login; the API key and the local bypass get 403.

includeStorageCredentials.description: Also put the storage credentials in the kit

RecoveryKitConfirmation.description: Exactly one: the kit's check code (case, spaces and dashes ignored), or the encryption password the user typed at create, typed again (not for a crypt remote created with a secret2, which needs the check code).

removeAll.description: restic unlock --remove-all: every lock, not only stale ones

prune.description: restic: prune the repository in this run

BackupTarget.description: One destination a Plex DB or *arr backup is written to, with its own schedule (params {integrationId, destinationId}). A destination whose kind is not local must be encrypted (400); adding one is S29.

cron.description: Empty with enabled false: manual backups only

acceptInsecureModes.description: Allow this target's local destination not to keep file modes (setting it is S29)
